notes: Proxy for the tool's own HTTPS requests (the firmware catalog). Empty proxyUrl uses the system default; when running as SYSTEM it falls back to the machine WinHTTP proxy (netsh winhttp set proxy). Set proxyUseDefaultCredentials to true only if the proxy in proxyUrl needs Windows sign-in (NTLM or Kerberos); as SYSTEM that is the computer account. The WinHTTP proxy always gets it.
